desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>The first time this Skill is used each Round, deal 1</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and attach</color> <color=#ffffff>Manifest Flame</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to this character. When this Skill is used again, consume 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Energy</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and this character</color> <color=#ffffff>prepares</color> <color=#ffffffa6>:</color> <color=#ffffff>Thunderous Symphony</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Manifest Flame</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>During this Round, the attached character's</color> <color=#ffffff>Physical DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>is converted to</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. The character's Normal Attack deals +1 DMG.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds): 2</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Thunderous Symphony</color>
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Prepare for 1 turn)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deal 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. If a</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>is on your side of the field, deal +2 DMG.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 6</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, deals 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to all opposing characters on standby.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) During this game, when your opponent is affected by</color> <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged reaction(s)</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, the reaction will be converted to the</color> <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> <color=#ffffffa6>reaction.</color>
<color=#ffffff>When this character is on the field, and Electric Shock is attached to the opponent's Action Card:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deal 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to the opposing character with the highest HP.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Summon</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deal 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 1</color> <color=#ffffffa6>(Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ffffff>When this card enters the field, or its usages increase:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Apply</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to 1 random card in your opponent's Hand.</color>

<color=#ffffffa6>Applies Electro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80ffd6>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80bfff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#80bfff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: Creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that deals 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)</color>

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Energy</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Characters must consume Energy to use their Elemental Bursts.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When characters use an Elemental Skill or a Normal Attack, they will gain 1 Energy.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Prepare Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Some Skills cannot be used directly. Instead, they need to be</color> <color=#ffffff>prepared</color> <color=#ffffffa6>over a certain number of turns. When it is a certain player's turn, and this player's active character is currently</color> <color=#ffffff>preparing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>a Skill, this player's turn will be skipped. If the Skill has finished being</color> <color=#ffffff>prepared</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, the character will directly use that Skill at this time. (Skills that require</color> <color=#ffffff>preparing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>cannot activated effects triggered by "using a Skill") Only active character can</color> <color=#ffffff>prepare</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Skills, and if an active character who is</color> <color=#ffffff>preparing</color> <color=#ffffffa6>a Skill gets switched off-field, their</color> <color=#ffffff>preparation</color> <color=#ffffffa6>will be interrupted.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Piercing DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Piercing DMG cannot be increased by any bonuses, but cannot be defended against using Shields or DMG Immunity either.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Lunar-Charged</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that deals 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit.)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>When the [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] is created or when its usages increase, apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Duration (Rounds)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Each time you reach the end of a Round,</color> <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> <color=#ffffffa6>-1.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>This card will be discarded immediately once</color> <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> <color=#ffffffa6>runs out.</color>
